title: Columns and lanes
text: Columns for stages and swimlanes for teams or priorities.

title: WIP limits
text: Warn about or block moves that exceed a column limit.

title: Keyboard moves
text: Grab a card with Space and move it with the arrow keys.

title: Server saves
text: Moves can be saved to a server and roll back when the save fails.

title: Undo and redo
text: Card moves can be undone and redone from the toolbar or keyboard.
